name: Eden Rock Hotel
positioning: Oetker Collection beach hotel, officially Eden Rock St Barths, set on a rocky promontory above white sandy beaches within walking distance of the village of St Jean
best_for: Travelers who want to stroll to the shops, bars and restaurants of St Jean village
Food lovers interested in evening fine dining masterminded by Jean-Georges Vongerichten
Guests choosing between rooms on the rock, along the beach or in beachside gardens

facts.text: Guests can stroll from the hotel to the shops, boutiques, bars and restaurants of the village of St Jean.
The rooms, suites and villas are individually designed.
Each room is decorated with varied materials, fine art and books.
Accommodation categories include Heavenly Beach Houses.
Daytime dining offers laid-back beachside menus.
Venues include the Sand Bar restaurant, Rémy Bar and Rémy's Club, and the Beach Bar.
The spa uses Ligne St Barth treatments, which combine natural ingredients with expert techniques.

highlights.text: The hotel sits on a rocky promontory overlooking white sandy beaches and a coral reef.
Fine dining cuisine at night is masterminded by chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.
Rooms, suites and villas are located either on the rock, along the beach or within beachside gardens.
Eden Spa offers treatments and massages using products created on the island, at the spa or in the privacy of the guest's room.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the exclusive St. Barth location.
WhataHotel notes the remote Caribbean island requires a private jet or connecting flights.
